zoneSizePositive: size must be greater than zero
zoneLayoutNotDeclared: layout “{{layout}}” is not declared in the template’s zoneLayouts
zoneBudgetBothAbsoluteAndPerArea: Both the absolute value and PerArea are filled in — half of the official templates do the same, this is acceptable
moConstructionPresetUnknown: Construction preset “{{preset}}” not found in the catalog (the game tolerates such references silently)
moBanPresetUnknown: Ban list preset “{{preset}}” not found in the catalog
moPlacementConnectionMissing: Connection “{{connection}}” from placementArgs not found in the variant
randomHireInitialUnitIncrementLength: randomHireInitialUnitIncrement (numbers, idx = random_hire 1..7): length {{length}} instead of the expected 7
randomHireEnableWeeklyUnitIncrementLengt: randomHireEnableWeeklyUnitIncrement (true/false, idx = random_hire 1..7): length {{length}} instead of the expected 7
grdNotArray: guardReactionDistribution is not an array (expected array[6]) — the field’s semantics are unknown (hypothesis)
grdLength: guardReactionDistribution: length {{length}} instead of the expected 6 “tiers” — the field’s semantics are unknown (hypothesis)
grdNotNumbers: guardReactionDistribution: all 6 values must be numbers (tier weights — hypothesis)
ehsIgnored: encounterHolesSettings is set, but gameRules.encounterHoles is not enabled — the field is ignored
zoneNoMc: The zone has no mandatory content (usually ≥1 group)
zoneMcGroupMissing: Group “{{group}}” not found in the root mandatoryContent
zoneCclStringAnomaly: The value is a string instead of an array (a known anomaly of stock templates; the game’s parser tolerates it)
zoneCclEmpty: The limit group list is empty
zoneCclGroupMissing: Limit group “{{group}}” not found in contentCountLimits
zonePoolUnknown: Pool “{{pool}}” not found in the catalog (total pools: {{total}})
mcGroupRuleConnectionMissing: A rule of group “{{group}}” references connection “{{connection}}” — not found in the variant
